notes.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

spells.name: Misdirection (At Will) (Self Only)
spells.text: You reshape the magic aura of one creature or object to resemble that of another. You designate one target as the primary target and the other as the secondary target. Effects that would detect auras on the primary target instead detect the same types of auras from the secondary target. A creature reading the aura can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. You can Dismiss the spell from up to a mile away.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Hatred of Red
items.text: Pairakas hate the color red. Zridi won't wear the color or willingly enter any place painted red. Given a choice, she'll attack a creature wearing red first. If barred from expressing her displeasure toward the color by force or some magical effect, she takes 2d6 mental damage at the end of her turn.

items.name: Bubonic Plague
items.text:
A creature can't remove the fatigued condition while infected

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude save

---

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Fatigued (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 2 and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 3, fatigued, and take 1d6 bleed every 1d20 minutes (1 day)

items.name: Change Shape
items.text:
Zridi can take the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid or animal. This doesn't change her Speed or her attack and damage modifiers with the Strikes, but it might change the damage type her Strikes deal.

---

items.name: Compelled Performance
items.text:
Frequency once per day

---

Effect Zridi grants the target a +2 status bonus to Performance checks for one week. The target must attempt a DC 26 Will save save.

Critical Success No further effect.

Success The target must Perform for 1 action on its next turn.

Failure The target must Perform for 3 actions on its next turn, undertaking a Performance task set by Zridi.

Critical Failure As failure, but Zridi can choose to delay the effect and trigger it at any point in the next week as a reaction.

Effect: Compelled Performance

items.name: Tormenting Dreams
items.text:
Frequency once per day

---

Effect Zridi torments a sleeping creature within 100 feet with visions of betrayals by loved ones and friends. The target must attempt a DC 26 Will save save, with the effects of the Nightmare spell.
